DESK COMPANION STUDY SURVEY

Help shape the future of student productivity robotics. Share your daily desk routines, smartphone distraction patterns, and preferences for embodied companion interventions.

PURPOSE // 01

Study Habit Telemetry

Quantifying average focus session lengths, frequency of phone checking, and fatigue cycles to calibrate FocusBot's adaptive Pomodoro timing models.

PURPOSE // 02

HRI Nudge Modality

Determining whether students respond better to physical head movements (gimbal nods), OLED eye animations, subtle chimes, or gentle voice synthesis.

PURPOSE // 03

Ethical & Privacy Standards

Gauging privacy expectations regarding edge camera processing versus cloud AI inference to ensure zero user surveillance or video recording.
